data.description:
## Goal

As a Herdr plugin maintainer, I want the performance harnesses and shared test fixtures ready to measure and verify a single consolidated `wl` read, so that the spawn-reduction target (parent AC3) is measurable before the consolidated command exists and every later slice can be tested without re-inventing fixtures.

This is the test-first slice of parent WL-0MVGYLU0S004WZUS: it adds measurement/verification infrastructure only and changes no production behaviour.

## Scope

- `bench/herdr-refresh-cycle.ts` and `bench/herdr-refresh-perf.ts` currently hard-code the five-query legacy set (`QUERIES`). Add a query-set selector (`--query-set legacy|consolidated`, default `legacy`) so the same harness measures one consolidated invocation per refresh tick while keeping the historical numbers comparable. In C1 the `consolidated` path is plumbing only: it must degrade cleanly (a clear "invocation not available yet" report/no-op, non-zero exit only when explicitly requested) because `wl worklist` does not exist until WL-C2.
- Add a reusable seeded-worklog fixture helper for the new CLI and herdr tests: root and child items spanning critical / in_review (completed + in-progress) / blocked / in-progress / open non-critical, at least one with a stored audit result, and at least one child under a root so `--root-only` filters are provably exercised.
- Extend `tests/bench/herdr-refresh-perf.test.ts` (or add a focused sibling) to cover the query-set selector plumbing and the consolidated-vs-legacy baseline ratio computation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `bench/herdr-refresh-cycle.ts` accepts `--query-set legacy` (default) and `--query-set consolidated`, issues exactly one invocation per tick in `consolidated` mode, and reports spawn counts / CPU-seconds for whichever set is selected.
- `bench/herdr-refresh-perf.ts` accepts the same selector and reports spawn count and latency for the selected set.
- An invalid `--query-set` value exits non-zero with an explicit error naming the valid values.
- The `consolidated` set is defined from a single exported constant so the CLI invocation vector lives in one place (no duplicated argv in bench and tests).
- A shared seeded-worklog fixture helper exists and is reused by at least one test, seeding the subset mix above (verified by assertions on the seeded data: ≥1 critical, ≥1 completed/in_review, ≥1 in-progress/in_review, ≥1 blocked root, ≥1 open non-critical, ≥1 child item).
- The reduction ratio is computed from a measured legacy baseline, not a hard-coded constant, and a test asserts the ratio arithmetic (e.g. 5 → 1 spawn yields 80 % reduction).
- No production source file (`src/`, `packages/herdr/src/` excluding tests) changes behaviour in this slice.
- Changed-scope tests pass and the full suite stays green.

- Traceability to parent WL-0MVGYLU0S004WZUS AC3: measured with `bench/herdr-refresh-cycle.ts` (F10), total CPU-seconds per 30 s cycle with 4 panes drops to ≤ 0.4× the pre-F4 baseline (≤ 63.8 CPU-s), ideally ~5× fewer spawns; this slice supplies the measurement harness for that comparison.
- Traceability to parent WL-0MVGYLU0S004WZUS AC8: the full project test suite must pass with the new changes; this slice keeps the suite green and documents its target.

## Minimal implementation

1. Export `LEGACY_WORKLIST_QUERIES` and `CONSOLIDATED_WORKLIST_QUERY` (single `worklist` argv) from one shared location importable by bench and tests.
2. Add `--query-set` parsing to both harnesses with validation and default `legacy`.
3. Route the tick loop through the selected set; in `consolidated` mode collect a clear "unavailable" diagnostic instead of a hard crash when the command is absent.
4. Factor the CPU/spawn summary maths into a helper that takes baseline and candidate measurements.
5. Add the seeded-worklog fixture helper next to the existing `tests/cli/cli-helpers.ts` helpers.
6. Add/extend bench tests for the selector and ratio arithmetic; update each harness's header doc comment.

## Key Files

- `bench/herdr-refresh-cycle.ts` — add `--query-set` selector, single-invocation consolidated tick
- `bench/herdr-refresh-perf.ts` — add `--query-set` selector and consolidated reporting
- `tests/bench/herdr-refresh-perf.test.ts` — selector + ratio arithmetic coverage
- `tests/cli/cli-helpers.ts` — seeded-worklog fixture helper
- `tests/cli/read-cache-spawn-reduction.test.ts` — consumes the shared query-set constants (no new assertions yet)

## Dependencies

- None (first slice).

## Deliverables

- Harness selector + shared query-set constants.
- Seeded-worklog fixture helper.
- Bench plumbing tests.
- Updated harness doc comments explaining the two query sets and the target ratio.

## Notes

- Keep the default `legacy` set byte-identical to today's five queries so F10's recorded numbers (159.44 → 83.58 CPU-s/cycle) remain comparable.
- Do not raise the 300 s budget in `tests/cli/read-cache-spawn-reduction.test.ts`; the consolidated path is expected to shorten that run, not lengthen it.
